prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Nothing independent confirms the accident: no witnesses, no photos and no other report.
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
On the afternoon of the reported collision, I responded to a side-impact crash at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 2's vehicle entered the intersection and struck the driver's side of a sedan operated by Driver 1. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel when I arrived, and Passenger was also present in the vehicle. Both were checked at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder, which fits the direction and force of the impact as I observed it.

No bystander reported seeing the collision, and no photographs of the scene were submitted to me. I found no other report of this incident. Some of the damage to Driver 1's vehicle may not have resulted from this impact, and I could not determine whether all of it occurred in this collision. I have no information about earlier damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy.
